senses.sense_definition: The change in direction or bending of a wave, such as light or sound, as it passes from one medium to another.

examples.text: The <w>refraction</w> of light makes the pencil appear bent in a glass of water.
Rainbows are formed by the reflection and <w>refraction</w> of sunlight inside raindrops.

senses.sense_definition: The degree to which a substance, such as a metal or mineral, can withstand high temperatures without melting or deforming.

examples.text: Engineers tested the thermal <w>refraction</w> of the new alloy before using it in the furnace.
The ceramic lining maintains its structural integrity due to its high <w>refraction</w> under intense heat.
